data.name: Jitul
data.gender_notes: Jitul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root ‘jit’ meaning ‘victory’ or ‘triumph’. The name Jitul is often given to a child born into a victorious family or as a symbol of the parent's hope for their child's future success. The name Jitul carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jitul usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jitul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jitul total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
